question: Will the Detroit Lions defeat the Buffalo Bills on Thursday, September 17, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: NFL road underdogs of exactly 3 points win straight up ~40% (published '+3 or shorter' road-dog bucket is 45.6% since 2003 but is inflated by pick'ems/+1.5 games). Market independently reproduces this: opener Bills -174/Lions +146 de-vigs to Lions ~39%, consensus now Bills -3 with Lions 40-41%, models 37-41%. No prediction-market contract matches this question — the Polymarket candidates are season-long playoff/championship markets with different subject, deadline and fine print, so evidence only, not an anchor. Case specifics all sit inside the line already: Bills 12-5 and healthy Josh Allen vs Lions 9-8 and missing both starting safeties, new-stadium home opener, Detroit winless vs Buffalo since 2006 (different rosters, negligible predictive weight). Week 1 is unplayed as of 2026-09-07, so a Sept 13 injury could move the line — that is variance, not a mean shift. No edge over an efficient NFL spread market; I stay at the base rate.
